messages:
aya: heads-up — spotted a weird HF->Redwood tokenizer delta on the new spm model. outputs differ by token id for sequences with user-defined symbols and leading ▁ (underscore) tokens.
lucas: can you paste a minimal repro? is this the same id-shift we saw before or something new? :thinking_face:
sam: saw something similar during quant experiments — special tokens from `user_defined_symbols` ended up aliasing to merged bpe tokens after conversion, causing collisions.
aya: repro (short):
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf-org/spm-example')
print(tok.encode('▁Hello world'))  # vs
# convert_spm_to_bpe.py output mapping: merge rules preserved, but some merged entries equal '<s>' id
```
aya: on HF: tokens -> [995, 24, 489]
aya: after our conversion to Redwood-bpe: tokens -> [3, 24, 489]  # id 3 is <s> in our vocab
devon: ugh that explains the eval regression on chat-bench — every prompt that started with a leading space got a bogus BOS token.
lucas: where did id 3 come from? was <s> already in the target vocab and we accidentally remapped while building merges?
sam: probable cause: spm has `user_defined_symbols` like `@@` or custom markers. conversion script concatenates merges and then runs a dedupe pass that appends new tokens at the end, but we also have an earlier remap step that assigns special token ids by name, not by reserved index. order-of-ops bug.
aya: attached logs from conversion job (models-bot posted job id):
models-bot: convert-job-1805123456 finished: warnings=2 errors=0
models-bot: warning: duplicate token string found in merged vocab -> assigning lowest free id
models-bot: warning: special token '<s>' present both in vocab and in special_tokens_map
devon: quick fix we used locally: force-assign special token ids before any dedupe/append steps, then reindex merges to reflect final ids. i.e. reserve special ids in the target vocab mapping.
sam: another edgecase: if a merge produces a token whose string equals an HF control symbol (like "▁</s>"), the current script strips control markers and then compares strings, causing a false positive collision.
lucas: good catch. we need three changes:
- ensure special tokens are pinned (pad/bos/eos/unk) in the target id space before we add merged tokens
- canonicalize control chars (preserve leading '▁' in comparisons) so we don't strip semantics
- add a regression test that tokenizes a few leading-space prompts and compares token ids HF vs converted
aya: can someone file a quick PR? this is interfering with evals and quant tests (perf numbers look fine but perplexity jumps).
devon: i'll draft the PR with tests and push to `spm-converter-fix`. will also add a tiny dataset of prompts that begin with punctuation/space.
sam: also flagging: the config.json chat_template mapping currently drops `add_bos` flag on conversion which masks the problem in some chat flows. need to preserve chat template handling when switching tokenizer types.
aya: thanks — please cc me on the PR. i ran a local patch that pinned special ids and that fixed the benchmark mismatch for the sample prompts (perplexity aligned within 0.2). :thumbsup:
lucas: awesome. after PR lands we should run the full chat-bench sweep + quantization runs to confirm no regression.
models-bot: job 1805123480: regression-suite queued (chat-bench + quant-ptq)
aya: great — keeping this thread for followups.
